identification: Narrow Japanese four-drawer softwood tansu (single case, 79 x 29 x 34 cm), sugi (cryptomeria) or similar pale softwood with darkened, worn and scratched surface; nailed drawer construction; each drawer has a small black iron lock plate with keyhole and an iron bail pull; iron carry ring on each side. Torn paper label remnants on the right of each drawer front. Plain, utilitarian piece, probably late Meiji to Showa (c1900-1950), not a fancy merchant's or clothing tansu. Estimate 150-250.

viewing_check: Pull every drawer: check runners, splits, borer holes, whether iron lock plates and pulls are original (hand-forged, same patina) and whether any key fits; look at back and base for replaced boards; check the paper labels for any writing/date.
